d:
Experience the ultimate Rajgir travel guide! Join us on a breathtaking journey as we take the famous Rajgir Ropeway (Rajgir Udankhatola) to reach the magnificent Vishwa Shanti Stupa (World Peace Stupa) atop Ratnagiri Hill.
In this full Rajgir vlog, we explore the spiritual beauty and historical significance of one of Bihar’s top tourist attractions. From the thrilling ropeway ride to the serene atmosphere of the Peace Pagoda, this video covers everything you need to know for your next trip to Rajgir.
